name: rial-app
description: Private, offline-first personal finance PWA (OMR). The app itself is dependency-free: index.html + manifest.json + sw.js. This package.json exists ONLY for dev tooling (icon build + tests).

scripts.test: node build-themes.js --check && node build-parser.js --check && node build-mime.js --check && node test-parser.mjs && node test-mime.mjs && node test.mjs && node test-dom.mjs && node test-browser.mjs

comment: test-browser.mjs auto-detects an installed Chrome/Edge; if neither is present it skips.
